links.note: Communalism as a division based on religion is 24079's definition. 24078 is the narrower case of religious differences entering politics as demands; this item asks what the division itself rests on.
The glossary definition of 'Feminist' - a person who believes in equal rights and opportunities for women and men - is attached to the women's-movement passage, which is 24076.

India against Sweden, Norway and Finland on women's participation - the Scandinavian counter-case in the public-versus-private passage, so 24073 (public roles as men's domain), the same concept as qid:105507 and qid:105513.

Asks the result of the political expression of gender division; the text attributes the improvement in women's public role to political mobilisation on the question, which is 24076. DEFECT: the printed key is 'None of the above' but option A ('has helped to improve women's role in public life') is the textbook statement - the key is wrong.
Men spending less time on household work is the sexual division of labour verbatim (24074): housework and child care assigned to women, work outside the home to men.

The child sex ratio falling to 800 in some states belongs to the list of ways women are disadvantaged (sex-selective abortion), i.e. gender division shaping life chances - 24072. Not 24074, which is about who does which work.
Communal violence, riots and massacre as its ugliest form is the third of 24080's forms ('sometimes in violence'). 24079 is the belief; this item asks how it manifests.

The incorrect statement is that the caste-politics relation runs only one way; the text's point is that politics also reshapes caste and throws up new caste groupings. That is 24082, not 24081 which is caste as the inherited social institution.
Family laws covering marriage, divorce, adoption and inheritance - the same glossary term as qid:105498, attached to the women's-movement demand for equality in personal and family life.

Urbanisation, literacy and occupational mobility breaking down caste hierarchy is the change-in-caste passage of 24081 (caste as a hereditary division shaping occupation and status). 24082 would require the item to reach politics or elections.

Definition item: communal politics as state power used to establish one religious group's domination, which is 24079's 'using religion as the basis of the nation'. 24080 lists the forms, which qid:105530 tests instead.
